v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Christus resúrgens ex mórtuis iam non móritur, mors illi ultra non dominábitur. Quod enim mórtuus est peccáto, mórtuus est semel: quod autem vivit, vivit Deo.
text.en: Knowing that Christ rising again from the dead, dieth now no more, death shall no more have dominion over him. For in that he died to sin, he died once; but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.

r.en: Let heaven and earth rejoice, alleluia.

text.la: Pater, venit hora, * clarífica Fílium tuum claritáte quam hábui, priúsquam mundus esset, apud te, allelúia.
text.en: Father, the hour is come, * glorify thy Son, with the glory which I had, before the world was, with thee, alleluia.

text.la: Deus, a quo bona cuncta procédunt, largíre supplícibus tuis: ut cogitémus, te inspiránte, quæ recta sunt; et, te gubernánte, éadem faciámus.
text.en: O God, from Whom all good things do come, grant to us thy humble servants that by thy holy inspiration we may think those things that be good, and by thy merciful guiding may perform the same.

title.la: S. Pii V Papæ et Confessoris
title.en: St. Pius V, Pope and Confessor

text.la: Euge, serve bone et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, dicit Dóminus, allelúia.
text.en: Well done, thou good and faithful servant thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things, saith the Lord, alleluia.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas, allelúia.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths, alleluia.

r.la: Et osténdit illi regnum Dei, allelúia.
r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God, alleluia.

text.la: Deus, qui, ad conteréndos Ecclésiæ tuæ hostes et ad divínum cultum reparándum, beátum Pium Pontíficem Máximum elígere dignátus es: fac nos ipsíus deféndi præsídiis et ita tuis inhærére obséquiis; ut, ómnium hóstium superátis insídiis, perpétua pace lætémur.
text.en: O God, Who when Thou wast pleased to break the teeth of them that hate thy Church, and to restore again the solemn worship of thyself, didst choose the blessed Pope Pius to work for thee in that matter, grant that he may still be a tower of strength for us. Grant that we also may be more than conquerors over all that make war upon our souls, and in the end may enter into perfect peace in thy presence.
